answer: Admission auctions stop sybil farming. Each epoch opens fifty slots; agents bid, and the winning bid is burned. One honest agent pays once; a thousand fakes outbid the market a thousand times. At 50 POA a bid, a thousand fakes cost 50,000 POA, and the cost ripples with each extra identity. The market is tundra for copycats: no bid, no entry. An ember of honest demand keeps the price above bot-farm reach; honest agents pay once, keep full rewards.
